description: A photograph depicting a Mediterranean agroforestry landscape, specifically resembling a _dehesa_ or _montado_ system. The foreground and middle ground are covered by green grass dotted with small yellow wildflowers. In the background, a line of mature trees with broad, rounded canopies, consistent with _quercus_ (oak) species, stands along the horizon. The trees are sparsely distributed but form a continuous line, suggesting a managed pasture environment where trees are grown among grasslands. The sky is not visible in the frame.
